medsl_president.name: County Presidential Election Returns
medsl_president.organization: MIT Election Data and Science Lab
medsl_president.description: County-level returns for U.S. presidential general elections from 2000 to 2024, compiled by the MIT Election Data and Science Lab. Each record gives the votes for a candidate and party in a county, with the total votes cast. Alaska reports results by election district, not by borough, and is included at the state level only. Connecticut is reported for its eight former counties. Kansas City, Missouri, is reported separately from the rest of Jackson County in the source and is included in Jackson County here.
medsl_president.restrictions: Public domain (CC0 1.0). Suggested citation: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, 2018, 'County Presidential Election Returns 2000-2024', https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/VOQCHQ, Harvard Dataverse.

_catalog.summary: The MIT Election Data and Science Lab reports how many votes each party's candidate for president received, by county and state, in each election since 2000.
